lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Luis Power is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Luis Power is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Luis kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Luis's gone." Vikram looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Luis." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Irving blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Intimidating Presence (Level 1). You don't have to fight. Most people decide not to, just looking at you.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Luis Power, 41 days. The mantle passes to Irving Hogan.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Irving Hogan, 39 — a night security guard. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Luis — and Luis is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Enzo, Vikram, Mmesoma and 4 more speak for Irving — "Luis trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Irving before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d72: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Irving Hogan is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d72: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d72: 🕯️ Irving is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d72: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d72: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d72: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d72: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d72: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d72: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
